description: Search tickets with the Freshdesk query DSL. The query VALUE is wrapped in double quotes automatically. Examples: `status:2 AND priority:3`, `created_at:>'2026-01-01'`, `agent_id:123`, `group_id:45`, `tag:'urgent'`. Freshdesk REST: GET /search/tickets.

page.description: Page number (1-10; search endpoints return 30 results per page and ignore per_page).

query.description: Freshdesk search query, e.g. "priority:3 AND status:2" (do NOT add surrounding quotes yourself — they are added for you).

name: freshdesk_search_tickets
title: Search tickets
